newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to list two more options next week.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to list two more options next week.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange said Thursday it would list options on Abercrombie & Fitch Co and Snyder Communications Inc on January 3.
Abercrombie & Fitch options will have opening strike pries of 15, 17-1/2 and 20, with initial expirations in January, February, May and August.
The options will trade in the Wal-Mart Stores Inc trading crowd.
Snyder Communications options will open with strikes of 22-1/2, 25 and 30.
Initial expirations will be in January, February, March and June.
The options will trade in the Johnson & Johnson trading crowd.
